quarterly_data.signal: Board secretary Wang Jun (Shandong listed companies' collective investor reception day, May 15, 2026): the company's 1.6T products keep ramping in volume and have long been in volume shipment, while 3.2T products are still in development and refinement; orders and shipments of its high-end optical modules keep rising and orders on hand are ample; NPO products are being refined technically and are in customer validation. He said the company has positioned itself across several technology routes, which it sees as more complementary than substitutive, that it has never issued earnings guidance, and that by optimising its product mix gross margin is expected to hold steady with some upside (hedged: 'expected').
quarterly_data.figure: 1.6T in volume shipment; 3.2T in development; no specific figure for orders

quarterly_data.signal: Board secretary Wang Jun (investor briefing, May 15, 2026) on capacity and supply: capacity utilisation is full and capacity keeps being expanded, including the Thailand capacity, with the added capacity to be released step by step; the supply chain is stable, and the company keeps building stocks of raw materials, especially core materials, and secures high-quality delivery of orders by bringing in alternative suppliers and signing supply-assurance agreements.
